name: Clinic Booking — Workflow A: Check & Book

nodes.name: Webhook — Tough Tongue AI Trigger
nodes.notes: SETUP: After importing, activate this workflow. Copy the generated webhook URL from this node and paste it into Tough Tongue AI > Custom Tools as the endpoint URL. Tough Tongue AI will POST a JSON body here.

nodes.name: Parse & Normalise Input
nodes.notes: Converts Tough Tongue AI's payload into clean date/time strings. Appointment duration is 30 minutes — change line 'const endMinutes = m + 30' if needed.

nodes.name: Google Calendar — Check Availability
nodes.notes: SETUP: Create a Google Calendar OAuth2 credential in n8n (Settings > Credentials > New > Google Calendar OAuth2 Api). Scopes needed: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar. Then replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GCAL_CREDENTIAL_ID above. Also set the GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID workflow variable (the calendar's email address, e.g. doctor@gmail.com or a dedicated calendar ID).

nodes.name: IF — Slot Free?
nodes.notes: True branch = slot is free → create event. False branch = slot is busy → find next available slot.

nodes.name: Google Calendar — Create Event
nodes.notes: Creates the appointment. Summary and description are auto-filled from patient data. Add guest email field if you collect patient email in the conversation.

nodes.name: Find Next Available Slot
nodes.notes: Scans forward in 30-min increments to find the next free window. Clinic closing hour defaults to 18:00 (6 PM). Change 'clinicEndHour' to match actual hours.

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "status": "booked",
  "confirmed_time": "{{$('Parse & Normalise Input').first().json.requestedTime}}",
  "confirmed_date": "{{$('Parse & Normalise Input').first().json.requestedDate}}",
  "patient_name": "{{$('Parse & Normalise Input').first().json.patientName}}",
  "event_id": "{{$json.id}}",
  "message_to_speak": "Great! Your appointment is confirmed for {{$('Parse & Normalise Input').first().json.requestedDate}} at {{$('Parse & Normalise Input').first().json.requestedTime}}. You will receive a WhatsApp confirmation shortly."
}

nodes.name: Respond — Booking Confirmed
nodes.notes: Returns JSON to Tough Tongue AI. The 'message_to_speak' field is what the AI will say aloud to the patient. Customise the Telugu text or keep English — Tough Tongue AI will handle TTS.

nodes.name: Respond — Suggest New Slot
nodes.notes: When the requested slot is busy, this tells Tough Tongue AI the next available time. Tough Tongue AI reads 'message_to_speak' back to the patient and waits for their yes/no.

nodes.name: Respond — Error Fallback
nodes.notes: Attach this to any node's error output via 'Add Error Handler' so the AI never hangs silently if something breaks.
